title: Typed domain identifiers
description: The typed domain identifiers a message carries. Every name is optional; a message states only the relationships it actually establishes. Property names are exactly the enum of https://utrace.dev/schemas/ids/identifier-name/v1.

client_id.description: The uTrace Client company that owns one product. Tenant scope for every client-scoped record.

utrace_user_id.description: A person globally inside uTrace. Global data is limited to communication preferences, do-not-contact state, participation count, and abuse controls.

client_user_id.description: That person's isolated relationship with one uTrace Client. Validation always requires the original client_user_id.

customer_account_id.description: A client-scoped B2B customer organization. Frequency counts unique customer accounts.

customer_membership_id.description: The join between a customer user and a customer account.

client_member_id.description: A staff relationship with one client. Exactly one owner and zero or more admins.

intake_item_id.description: One routed unit of Customer Surface input.

product_signal_id.description: One independently gateable and validatable product outcome.

outreach_attempt_id.description: One private invitation or re-contact attempt against the pinned contact budget.

session_id.description: One Interview Session: a live interviewing or validation encounter.

preview_runtime_allocation_id.description: Exclusive access to a full running copy of the client product. Grants product access, not code-writing authority.

environment_lease_id.description: The attempt-scoped fenced lease that alone grants implementation workspace mutation.

implementation_attempt_id.description: One gate-approved attempt. At most one nonterminal attempt exists per Product Signal.

preview_version_id.description: One immutable candidate bound to one attempt and exact source/build artifact.

validation_attempt_id.description: One originating-user validation of one exact Preview Version and prepared dataset.

case_file_id.description: The client-facing output record. An eligible Product Signal owns at most one.

delivery_id.description: One delivery of an output, such as the single draft PR bound to the validated commit manifest.

job_id.description: One durable responsibility with a frozen input, deadline, budget, and concurrency key.

job_run_id.description: One leased execution of a Job.

command_id.description: One immutable, single-purpose request. The idempotency boundary and provider idempotency key.

evidence_window_id.description: One bounded selection of observations promoted as evidence.

artifact_id.description: One immutable stored artifact addressed by digest.

ingestion_receipt_id.description: One received telemetry batch at the ingress journal.

normalization_run_id.description: One reprocessing pass over a retained receipt.

observation_id.description: One browser observation record. Browser records deduplicate by this identifier.

browser_stream_id.description: One top-document browser runtime export stream. Reload or full navigation starts a new stream.

server_stream_id.description: One server SDK service process export stream.

extension_binding_id.description: One authenticated extension binding to the selected preview tab.

document_attachment_id.description: One browser SDK attachment to a document in the bound preview tab.

preview_environment_id.description: The preview environment an observation or span was produced in.

runtime_id.description: One embedded browser SDK runtime instance inside a document.

voice_run_id.description: One provider voice connection. Every provider connection creates a new voice run.
